name: com.qa.perfkit
description: Frame-drop context for QA/staging builds of any game: when the flag file perfkit.on exists, logs each dropped frame with the game's scene and context, its CPU/render/GPU frame times and memory, plus a heartbeat, to its own logcat tag (PerfKit). Dormant otherwise: no per-frame cost. No game references, no dependencies. Compiled out when PRODUCTION or QAKIT_DISABLED is defined.
